The allergy form crashed outside the chart because it was only registered in the patient-chart workspace group and read its patient from that group's props. Opening it from the order basket launched that group with no props, so it failed on `groupProps` being null. The fix launches an exported allergy-form workspace instead, which takes the patient from the host's window props.

**Why it crashed:** The chart's allergy form read `groupProps: { patient, patientUuid }` directly. Outside the chart there is no patient-chart group, so the props were null and it threw `Cannot read properties of null (reading 'patientUuid')`. That also broke every action button registered to that group. The chart PR records this symptom and the ward PR records the same error (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-allergies-app/src/allergies/allergies-form/allergy-form.workspace.tsx:616-634`, PR 3353, PR 2561).

**What is launched instead:** The dispensing app registers `dispensing-order-basket-add-allergy-workspace`, which points at `@openmrs/esm-patient-allergies-app#exportedAllergyFormWorkspace`, in the `fill-prescription-window`. The order basket passes that name as `allergyFormWorkspaceName`. The "+" control then launches it as a child workspace with `formContext: 'creating'`. The exported wrapper gets `patient` and `patientUuid` from window props and renders the same presentational `AllergyForm`. The chart wrapper is unchanged in behaviour.

**Which change fixed it:** The substantive fix is chart commit `160e8d0` (PR 3353), which added the exported workspace and the optional launcher. The dispensing app's own registration and wiring came from commit `120d22e` (PR 854). The dispensing attribution comes from Falkon provenance on `routes.json`; I did not read that commit's diff. The ward companion is PR 2561 (merge commit `3368e9e`).

**Ticket:** None is recorded. The PR and commit records carry no ticket key, and the PR bodies have an empty "Related Issue" section.
